value.name: Marylin confirms engagement
value.description: Marylin confirms to Ramona that she said yes to the marriage proposal.

value.name: Marylin inspects antique bowl
value.description: Marylin examines an antique Chinese bowl and asks about its age and origin.
evidence: She picks up an antique Chinese bowl.

value.name: Friends debate bowl dynasty
value.description: Ramona and Sarah joke about whether the bowl is Ming or Tong and which dynasty is older.
evidence: SARAH It's not Ming. It's Tong.
RAMONA Is Tong older than Ming?
MARYLIN I think Ming is older than Tong.

value.name: Salesman identifies prayer bowl
value.description: The salesman identifies the object as a Chinese Prayer Bowl from the Chen dynasty.
evidence: SALESMAN That is a Chinese Prayer Bowl. It's Chen dynasty.

value.name: Marylin buys the bowl
value.description: Marylin decides to purchase the bowl and adds it to the growing pile of antiques.
evidence: He sets it aside next to the formidable pile of loot the girls have accumulated.

value.name: Marylin ends shopping trip
value.description: Marylin says she cannot continue shopping and suggests the group go to lunch instead.
evidence: MARYLIN I can't do this anymore. Let's get some lunch.

value.name: Sarah mentions rugs stop
value.description: Sarah reminds Marylin that they were supposed to stop at Mansour for rugs.
evidence: SARAH What about rugs? I thought we were stopping at Mansour?

value.name: Marylin pays with platinum card
value.description: Marylin hands over her Platinum Visa to pay for the antiques, and the salesman addresses her as Mrs. Massey.
evidence: She hands him the Platinum Visa.
SALESMAN (Glances at it) Very good, Mrs. Massey.

value.name: Marylin idly handles candelabra
value.description: After paying, Marylin absently fingers an antique guided candelabra, suggesting distraction or contemplation.
evidence: Marylin absently fingers an antique guided candelabra.
